title: Q-SHIP-slices: the remaining slices of the specification code ship, one bounded pull request each
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** SHIP-PLAN-1 (doctrine/ship-plan.json): slices S08, S09 and S11 have not landed on main
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation shipplan --check
**Status:** closed

Run `python3 -m foundation shipplan --next`: it names the slice and where its material is stored in the private repository (wip/code/). Build it on the latest main with wip/code/slicing/ship2.sh, run the repo checks locally (serverside, claimcode, rulerefs, docs_audit, writeback, coldstart, gaplint, the seed and foundation tests), push with push.sh, open one pull request. Conformance and docs go last: the manifest needs every test merged.

**Prediction:** shipplan.slices_landed >= 10 within 72 h
**Out of scope:** deleting any unmerged work (it is stored in ultrastable/ops under wip/); a change over 60 files or 3,000 lines (SMALL-CHANGE-1); specification text on a public branch (DISCLOSE-1).

size: M

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation shipplan --check` exits 0 on main. It exits 1 while any entry of doctrine/ship-plan.json has not landed.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-26T20:05:07Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.2 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
